x-runner-discovery.summary: Request ratification for an assigned completed match result.
x-runner-discovery.title: Request result ratification

x-runner-discovery.summary: Request supervised withdrawal of an assigned finished result in an open event.
x-runner-discovery.title: Withdraw a finished result

reviews.when: The assigned result’s related event is open; the result is finished; it records exactly two winner game wins and zero or one loser game wins; and it has no integrity hold.
reviews.then: Propose changing only the result state to ratified. Completion requires separate supervised execution after approval.
refused: Refuse if the event is not open.
Refuse if the result is not finished, its score is not a qualifying best-of-three score, or it has an integrity hold.
reviews.human_review: A valid championship-stage request requires league-supervisor review. A valid qualifying-stage request not automatically approved, including a rolling-limit overrun, also requires league-supervisor review.

examples.scenario: An assigned qualifying result has an open event, is finished, records 2–1, and has no integrity hold.
examples.result: The ratification request is valid and may be considered for automatic approval subject to rolling limits.

examples.scenario: An assigned championship result has an open event, is finished, records 2–0, and has no integrity hold.
examples.result: The valid request requires league-supervisor review.

examples.scenario: An assigned result is finished with a 2–1 score, but its event is closed.

reviews.when: The assigned result is finished, its related event is open, no integrity hold exists, and a nonempty withdrawal reason of at most 200 characters is supplied.
reviews.then: Send the valid withdrawal request to league-supervisor review. After approval, supervised execution can change only the result state to withdrawn and store the supplied withdrawal reason.
refused: Refuse if the result is not finished, the related event is not open, an integrity hold exists, or the withdrawal reason is empty or exceeds 200 characters.
reviews.human_review: Every valid withdrawal request requires league-supervisor review. Invalid requests are refused and are not routed to review. Completion can occur only once execution is separately enabled and a worker is running.

examples.scenario: An assigned referee requests withdrawal of a finished result in an open event, with no integrity hold and reason "Duplicate entry".
examples.result: The request is valid and is sent to league-supervisor review.

examples.scenario: A referee requests withdrawal of a ratified result.
examples.result: The request is refused because only finished results can be withdrawn.

examples.scenario: A referee requests withdrawal of a finished result in an open event with no integrity hold and a nonempty reason.
examples.result: The valid request requires league-supervisor review before any supervised completion.

verdict: Old singleton proof not reused: two-outcome candidate yields no established counting interpretation and both normal review responses fail COUNTING_SUPPORT_MISSING. This is a passed stale-proof refusal, not completed evolution.
